correctness.rationale: For the stated six-point blowup, the geometric line divisor has 27 rational components and, under the no-Eckardt hypothesis, 135 ordinary nodes with 270 normalization branches. The exact normalization point-count identity establishes the zeta formula in all degrees. The 109-rank integer graph-cycle lattice and its signed permutation exact sequence prove the integral torus order formula. The provided Python 3 checker independently builds the 135-edge graph, verifies all 720 permutations and eleven class profiles, and cross-checks twelve extension degrees; the infinite claim does not rely on finite tests.

value.rationale: A complete invariant of the natural reduced boundary of a classical 27-line cubic geometry is determined for every six-point Frobenius type; 135 node orbits and 270 flags, not just component splitting, are needed. The two point-free classes and nonsplit rational nodes (six in type 2^3) give substantive arithmetic behavior, and the integral cycle sequence yields the full order of the 109-dimensional Picard torus. These data have a plausible role in finite-field line-boundary degeneration arithmetic rather than a selected arbitrary small test.
